seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Bartow, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Bartow, Florida for 2026: Santa visits at the Polk County History Center, Milk and Cookies With Santa, plus Mulberry and Fort Meade.
lede: Bartow keeps Christmas close to downtown, with Santa visiting the Polk County History Center, a Festival of Wreaths and a city Milk and Cookies morning at the Civic Center.
celebrates: Three local hosts run the season. The Polk County History Center at 100 E. Main St. hosts Selfies with Santa in Santa's study on reserved Saturdays and a Jingle and Mingle afternoon during its Festival of Wreaths. The City of Bartow calendar lists Milk and Cookies With Santa at the Civic Center, plus library holiday programs at the Bartow Library. Main Street Bartow, at 180 S. Central Ave, lists a Christmas Parade on December 11. Nearby Mulberry and Fort Meade add a tree lighting and a parade.
lastyear: The Polk County History Center's Festival of Wreaths is in its 16th year in 2026, so the 2025 festival was the 15th. The county page for Selfies with Santa says Santa and his elves are returning to his study at the history center, which means the Santa visits are a repeat tradition there. Main Street Bartow's Christmas Parade page also offers a parade entry application, which shows the parade is organized each year for local groups.
facts: The Festival of Wreaths at the Polk County History Center is billed as the 16th annual. The History Center sits at 100 E. Main St. and is run by Polk County Government. The Bartow Civic Center is at 2250 S. Floral Ave. and the Bartow Library is at 2150 S. Broadway Ave. Main Street Bartow is at 180 S. Central Ave. The library's December calendar lists wreath crafting, holiday photo mini sessions and a teen anime holiday party.
trains: Bartow does not have a holiday train of its own on our list. The Florida Railroad Museum in Parrish runs the North Pole Express on select evenings from November 27 to December 22, 2026, a 45 minute ride with Santa, according to our Auburndale page. The Robert W. Willaford Railroad Museum in Plant City is a free depot museum with a 1963 Seaboard caboose. The Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa has a rail exhibit.

kidfact: Santa has a study at the Polk County History Center in Bartow, and kids can book a time to take a selfie with him there.
faq: The Polk County History Center hosts Selfies with Santa and the Festival of Wreaths, the City of Bartow lists Milk and Cookies With Santa at the Civic Center, and Main Street Bartow lists a Christmas Parade. Mulberry and Fort Meade nearby add a tree lighting and a parade.
Can kids meet Santa in Bartow?

Yes. The Polk County History Center offers Selfies with Santa in his study on November 28, December 5 and December 19, and reservations are required. The City of Bartow also lists Milk and Cookies With Santa at the Civic Center on December 12, with games, crafts and storytimes.
Does Bartow have a Christmas parade?

Main Street Bartow lists a Christmas Parade on December 11, 2026. Its page prints the date only, so we did not build a card yet. Check Main Street Bartow for the start time and route before you go, and see our nearby Fort Meade parade on this page.
Where is the Polk County History Center?

The History Center is at 100 E. Main St., Bartow, FL 33830, in downtown Bartow. Reservations for Selfies with Santa are made by calling 863-534-4386 or emailing historycenter@polkfl.gov, and the Jingle and Mingle afternoon is on December 12 from 11 am to 3 pm.
Are there events in Mulberry and Fort Meade?

Yes. Mulberry holds a Christmas Tree Lighting and Cookie Stroll on December 4, and the Fort Meade Chamber of Commerce lists a Candy Cane Lane Christmas Parade on December 12. Both are on this page because those towns have no page of their own.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bartow for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Selfies with Santa at the Polk County History Center) through December 19, with the Christmas Tree Lighting and Cookie Stroll in Mulberry (December 4), Milk and Cookies With Santa at the Bartow Civic Center, Jingle and Mingle at the Polk County History Center and the Fort Meade Candy Cane Lane Christmas Parade (all December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Bartow

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Bartow, Mulberry and Fort Meade

  • Parades and tree lightings: Mulberry Christmas Tree Lighting and Cookie Stroll (December 4) and Fort Meade Candy Cane Lane Christmas Parade (December 12)

  • Season: November 28 to December 19
